corrected_swing_contract.camera: The existing fixed front view with slight downward view; use existing painted frame/seat identity.
corrected_swing_contract.axis: Pendulum rotates about the horizontal left-to-right suspension beam. Seat travels fore and aft, toward and away from the camera; no lateral slide, yaw or horizontal swaying of the frame.
corrected_swing_contract.fixed: Frame, hooks, support posts, camera and lighting.
corrected_swing_contract.required_new_pixels: Fresh seat inclination, seat/backrest surface visibility, foreshortening and occlusion in individually drawn poses; ropes attach to fixed upper pivots and corresponding seat sockets. Source deformation is not a substitute for these drawings.
corrected_swing_contract.physics: Constant physical rope length; speed highest through lowest center, slower near the apices. Apparent rope length and seat projection follow perspective.
